# The unpublished runnable examples get their records and captions

## Context

[The inventory](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6918253093) of 16 Nov 2026 counts 154 runnable entries; the catalog publishes 72. A leaf of #21140, for the Engine 14 cut on Mon 23 Nov.

## The Problem

82 runnable examples and apps can be reached only by their own URL. Three open leaves cover part of them: #20694 (buttons, containers, lists, menus, trees), #20695 (the visual components, canvas and wrappers) and #20696 (State & Data). Nothing covers the rest: `tabs`, `layout/card`, `layout/cube`, `panel`, `viewport`, `toolbar/*`, the six `functional/*`, `dashboard/base`, the four `component/mwc/*`, `worker/task`, `remotesApi/basic`, `preloadingAssets`, `sitemap`, `videoMove`, and the apps `email`, `finance`, `legit` and `route`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`: one record per example with `id`, `name`, `family`, `feature`, `lookFor`, `scope`, `urls`, `sourceUrl`, `image`.
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainerController.spec.mjs` rejects a family record without `feature` or `lookFor`.
- A record without a cover stays in the catalog and shows no card (#21124), so a record can land before its cover.
- Design authority: the Engine 14 slate decides which of these stay; the caption shape is the one #20500 set (`feature`: what the example proves; `lookFor`: one action and its visible result).

## The Fix

For every entry above that the slate keeps: one record with its group id, a `feature` sentence and a `lookFor` sentence, written after opening the example. Data only; one pull request.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] Every entry named above has a record, or the pull request names the slate row that retires it.
- [ ] Each record's group is one of the bound groups; `alsoIn` where the slate says so.
- [ ] Each caption was written against the running example: `feature` names what it proves, `lookFor` one action and what to see.
- [ ] No caption names a commercial feature (the rule of #20498, until 1 Dec).
- [ ] The unit spec passes with the new totals; the catalog's order keeps the established blocks.
- [ ] No cover is added here.

## Out of Scope

Covers; the entries of #20694, #20695 and #20696; changing an example; child windows, `dashboard/crossWindowWitness` and `apps/ai/neural-link` (not for the visitor catalog).

## Avoided Traps

- **A caption written from the source file.** Two readers called such cards toys; the sentence comes from running it.
- **A record for everything.** Inventory is not publication: the slate may retire an entry.

## Related

Parent #21140 · #20694, #20695, #20696 (the neighbouring record leaves) · #21124 (a record without a cover shows no card).
